metadata.title: Memgraph Schema and Vector Index Setup

story.iWant: the Memgraph schema (constraints, vector index) initialized and validated
story.soThat: knowledge nodes can be stored with embeddings and queried via Cypher + vector search

task.title: Create schema initialization script init-memgraph.mjs
task.subtask: Create uniqueness constraint: CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (n:Node) ASSERT n.nodeId IS UNIQUE;
Create vector index: CREATE VECTOR INDEX knowledge_index ON :Node(embedding) WITH CONFIG {"dimension": 1024, "capacity": 50000, "metric": "cos", "scalar_kind": "f16"};
Verify all 8 edge types can be created between test nodes (DEPENDS_ON, DERIVED_FROM, INFORMS, REFINES, VALIDATES, SUPERSEDES, CONFLICTS_WITH, ENABLES)
Make script idempotent — check for existing constraints/indexes before creating, use IF NOT EXISTS where supported or catch duplicate errors gracefully

task.title: Validate vector search capability
task.subtask: Insert a test node with all expected properties (nodeId, projectId, type, phase, status, maturity, title, summary, tags, embedding)
Generate a dummy 1024-dimensional embedding vector (normalized random floats)
Execute vector search query: CALL vector_search.search('knowledge_index', 5, $testVector) YIELD node, similarity
Verify the test node is returned with similarity > 0.9
Clean up test data after validation

task.title: Verify edge type creation and traversal
task.subtask: Create two test nodes and one edge of each of the 8 types between them
Run traversal query: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) RETURN type(r), a.nodeId, b.nodeId
Verify all 8 edge types are returned
Verify edges carry weight property as specified in the architecture doc

task.title: Add init-memgraph to setup flow
task.subtask: Update setup-memgraph.sh or create a post-startup hook to call init-memgraph.mjs after Memgraph container is ready
Add retry logic for cases where Memgraph is still starting up (wait for Bolt port)
Log schema initialization results to stdout

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: A uniqueness constraint exists on Node.nodeId
A vector index knowledge_index is created on :Node(embedding) with config: dimension 1024, capacity 50000, metric cosine, scalar f16
All 8 edge types are usable (DEPENDS_ON, DERIVED_FROM, INFORMS, REFINES, VALIDATES, SUPERSEDES, CONFLICTS_WITH, ENABLES)
A test node with a dummy 1024-dim embedding can be inserted and retrieved via vector search
The schema initialization script is idempotent (safe to re-run without errors or duplication)

doc.title: Mycelium-Labs Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Node properties, vector index config (dimension 1024, capacity 50000, metric cos, scalar_kind f16), 8 edge types with weights (DEPENDS_ON 1.0, DERIVED_FROM 0.7, INFORMS 0.3, REFINES 0.5, VALIDATES 0.6, SUPERSEDES 0.8, CONFLICTS_WITH 0.9, ENABLES 0.5), wikilink-to-edge mapping table

doc.title: Mycelium-Labs Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Vector search query syntax: CALL vector_search.search('knowledge_index', 10, $queryEmbedding) YIELD node, similarity WHERE similarity > 0.6

doc.title: Mycelium-Labs Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Docker container config: image memgraph/memgraph:latest, port 7687, memory-limit=512, storage-parallel-schema-recovery=true, 600M container memory limit

doc.title: Mycelium-Labs Architecture Document
doc.snippet: D2: Memgraph chosen for semantic + structural search combined (native vector index + Cypher traversal). D3: Voyage AI voyage-3-large (1024-dim) chosen for superior code retrieval

package.name: neo4j-driver
package.reason: Bolt protocol client for Memgraph connectivity — already installed in daemon/scripts

constraints.constraint: Memgraph container must be running and accessible on bolt://localhost:7687 before schema init (Story MY-1.1 prerequisite)
Vector index uses f16 scalar kind to halve memory vs f32 — critical given 512MB Memgraph memory limit on t4g.small
Script must be idempotent — safe to re-run without errors or duplication; use IF NOT EXISTS or catch duplicate errors
All files placed under /home/ubuntu/scripts/ on the EC2 instance (daemon/scripts/ in repo maps to this)
Node.js ESM modules (.mjs extension) — match existing pattern in test-memgraph.mjs
No additional npm dependencies — neo4j-driver already installed

interface.name: Memgraph Bolt Protocol
interface.details: No auth required for local Memgraph. Use neo4j-driver to connect. Session-based query execution.

interface.name: Cypher DDL — Uniqueness Constraint
interface.query: CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (n:Node) ASSERT n.nodeId IS UNIQUE;

interface.name: Cypher DDL — Vector Index
interface.query: CREATE VECTOR INDEX knowledge_index ON :Node(embedding) WITH CONFIG {"dimension": 1024, "capacity": 50000, "metric": "cos", "scalar_kind": "f16"};

standards.standard: Script-level validation — init-memgraph.mjs self-validates by querying constraints and indexes after creation
Vector search validation — insert test node with 1024-dim dummy embedding, retrieve via vector search, verify similarity > 0.9
Edge traversal validation — create test nodes with all 8 edge types, traverse and verify all types returned with correct weights
Idempotency validation — run script twice, verify no errors on second run and no duplicate constraints/indexes

locations.location: daemon/scripts/init-memgraph.mjs (self-validating script with built-in test routines)

ideas.idea: After creating constraint, query SHOW CONSTRAINT INFO to verify nodeId uniqueness constraint exists
After creating vector index, query SHOW INDEX INFO to verify knowledge_index exists with correct config
Create 2 test nodes and 8 edges (one per type), run MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) RETURN type(r) and verify all 8 types present with correct weights
Insert node with random 1024-dim vector, search with same vector, assert similarity > 0.99 (self-match)
Run init-memgraph.mjs twice in succession — second run must complete without errors and produce same schema state
